name: cooking_unit_convert
description: Kitchen unit conversion: cups, tablespoons, teaspoons, fluid ounces, pints and millilitres under a stated cup definition (US customary 236.588 mL, US legal 240 mL, metric 250 mL, UK 284 mL); grams, ounces and pounds; volume to weight by a given density in g/mL (or the bundled ingredient table: water now, USDA FoodData Central rows when the generator's fetch succeeds); oven temperatures in °C, °F and gas marks (UK table and exact scale).

from.description: ml, l, dl, cl, cup, tbsp, tsp, fl_oz, pint (in system); us_cup, legal_cup, metric_cup, uk_cup, us_tbsp, us_tsp, au_tbsp, us_fl_oz, uk_fl_oz, us_pint, uk_pint; g, kg, mg, oz, lb; C, F, gas_mark

system.description: Meaning of cup, tbsp, tsp, fl_oz and pint

ingredient.description: Bundled ingredient for volume <-> weight (list: true lists them)

density.description: Grams per millilitre, instead of ingredient

list.description: List the ingredients, cup systems and gas marks

catalog.source: NIST Handbook 44 App. C (US customary measures); 21 CFR 101.9(b)(5)(viii) (US legal cup); NIST SP 811 App. B.8 (imperial); USDA FoodData Central SR Legacy household measures (public domain); the UK gas mark table; transcribed and fetched by tools/catalog/data/cooking_unit_convert.py
